newsitem.title: USA: Fed stays out of market, fed funds 5-5/16 percent.
newsitem.headline: Fed stays out of market, fed funds 5-5/16 percent.

text.p: The Federal Reserve opted to stay out of the open market Monday, traders said.
Analysts had forecast three-day system repurchase agreements, given a projected $3.5 billion to $6 billion daily add need for the remaining three days of the maintenance period.
The non-action wasn't a big surprise, since Fed Funds -- at 5-5/16 percent -- were not under pressure, and the 14-day system RPs from about 10 days ago is still on the books.
Analysts look for a bill pass later this week.
